title: Touhou Hisoutensoku ~ Choudokyuu Ginyoru no Nazo o Oe - Maximum Overdrive!!! ~ Solar Sect of Mystic Wisdom ~ Nuclear Fusion (Remix)
description:
☢ 𝙈𝙮 𝙪𝙡𝙩𝙞𝙢𝙖𝙩𝙚 𝙣𝙪𝙘𝙡𝙚𝙖𝙧 𝙛𝙪𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣 𝙬𝙞𝙡𝙡 𝙗𝙪𝙧𝙣 𝙪𝙥 𝙚𝙫𝙚𝙧𝙮 𝙗𝙤𝙙𝙮, 𝙝𝙚𝙖𝙧𝙩, 𝙜𝙝𝙤𝙨𝙩, 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙛𝙖𝙞𝙧𝙮! ☢

Decided to do a hardcore remix of Utsuho Reiuji's theme from Touhou 12.3: Hisoutensoku. Definitely another one of the cooler themes in the series and a fantastic arrangement of the original Touhou 11 theme!!

This baby can fit [final] boss fights, intense stages, underground caverns (specifically lava / fire-themed), castles (specifically fire-themed), and stages that have a giant warning in the front of the screen.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- "Bonus End" is disabled.
